My friend invited me to play board games, but we haven't picked a place. Can you see what's good downtown?

thought: 比较几家合适的桌游店
Compare a few board game cafés
reply:
我给你列三家。要是人多，可以优先问有没有大桌或包间。

时光桌游吧：位于小寨华旗国际A座，电话 029-85418760。是小寨片区比较老牌的桌游吧，但是环境一般，价格偏高。

心动桌游俱乐部：在莱安中心T6-21703室。环境更新、店面更大，很多带独立包间，适合6人以上的大聚会。

叙事者营地桌游馆：位于大唐不夜城长安C位10号商铺，在景区里，过去得多留点时间。

Here are three places. If you've got a big group, ask about large tables or private rooms first.

Shiguang Board Game Café: Tower A, Xiaozhai Huaqi International. 029-85418760. It's been around a long time, but the place is nothing special and it's on the pricey side.

Xindong Board Game Club: Room T6-21703, Lai'an Center. Newer, bigger, and with plenty of private rooms. Good for groups of six or more.

Storyteller Camp Board Games: Shop 10, Chang'an C-Spot, Grand Tang Mall. It's in the tourist district, so give yourself extra time to get there.

He likes her but doesn't feel like making a point of going over. He's getting back to the game. A quick reply is enough. Meeting her doesn't need to become a job.

thought: Let him get back to the game
reply: 好，先去玩你的。你们既然在同一桌，有合适的话头再聊也来得及。
Okay, go play. You're at the same table. If something comes up later, you can talk then.

lines: 我坐下了，等下一局呢。我旁边那男生外套上写着 ARTX，你帮我看一下这个衣服是什么牌子？贵不贵？
I'm sitting down waiting for the next round. The guy next to me has ARTX on his jacket. Can you look up what brand that is? Is it expensive?
她在桌游店看到一件外套，想知道牌子和大概价位。现在只知道标志，能说说品牌定位，具体款式和价格还判断不了。
She spotted a jacket at the café and wants the brand and a rough price. I can tell her where the brand sits, but a logo isn't enough to identify the exact jacket or price.

reply: ARTX 走的是偏贵的设计师品牌路线，外套有些款能卖到几千。不过光看标志认不出他穿的是哪件，具体多少钱还得看款式。
ARTX is on the pricier end of designer labels. Some of their jackets go for a few thousand yuan. I can't tell which one he's wearing from the logo alone, so the exact price depends on the jacket.

lines: 我坐下了，等下一局呢。我旁边那男生外套上写着 ARTX，你帮我看一下这个衣服是什么牌子？贵不贵？

lines: 啊这么贵啊。刚才等人洗牌的时候聊起来，他说上次逛街就多看了那件两眼，他妈还真记住了，后来买来当生日礼物。哎他妈还挺记得他喜欢啥的。

Whoa, that much? We got talking while someone was shuffling. He said he looked at that jacket a little longer than usual when he was out shopping. His mom actually remembered and bought it for his birthday. Aw, she really pays attention to what he likes.
她原本好奇衣服的价格，现在更在意他妈妈记得他的喜好。可以回应这件具体的小事，顺着她的发现聊一句。
She started out curious about the price. What stuck with her was that his mom remembered what he liked. I can respond to that little detail she noticed.

thought: Pick up on what she noticed
reply: 他没专门开口要，她还记得他在店里多看了两眼。这种自己都快忘了的事，还有人记得，收到时应该挺惊喜的。
He didn't even ask for it, and she remembered him looking at it in the store. It must've been a nice surprise to have someone remember something he'd probably almost forgotten himself.

lines: 我靠，我靠，我靠，刚才打桌游的时候有个女生，我感觉她绝对对我有意思！！！
Holy shit, holy shit, holy shit. There was this girl at board games just now, I swear she's definitely into me!!!
他一上来就说对方对他有意思，还没讲怎么回事。先听听两人在桌上说了什么，再判断他看到的是什么信号。
He opened by saying she's into him, but he hasn't told me what happened. Hear what they said at the table before trying to read it as a signal.

reply: 你看起来挺高兴的。刚才玩的时候她做了什么，让你觉得她对你有意思？
You sound pretty excited. What did she do while you were playing that made you think she's into you?

lines: 就是我们不刚玩完桌游吗，然后刚才玩的时候，我说话别人都不理我，就她回应我，而且就她有时候和我对视一下啥的
So we just finished playing, right? Whenever I said something nobody else answered, but she did. And sometimes we'd make eye contact and stuff.
他最在意的是没人接话时她接了，还跟他有几次对视。这些能说明两人聊得上。可以鼓励他试着认识她，也可以建议他再看看。
What stayed with him was that she answered when nobody else did, and that they made eye contact a few times. They do seem able to talk. I can encourage him to get to know her or give it more time.

reply: 她愿意接你的话，你跟她聊起来也舒服。你要还想认识她，可以试着问能不能加个微信，先从那局桌游聊起。
She was happy to answer you, and talking to her felt easy. If you'd like to get to know her, you could ask to add her on WeChat and start with the game you just played.

thought: 先看看她平时怎么待人
See how she is with others
reply: 她接你的话，可能是跟你聊得来，也可能是她平时就愿意照顾桌上的人。你可以先再相处一会儿，没必要现在就猜她对你有没有意思。

She might have answered because you get along, or because she's the sort of person who makes everyone at the table feel included. You can spend a little more time around her. You don't have to guess how she feels right now.

lines: 我靠不敢啊，我在我妹面前是正人君子，我问这感觉跟个变态一样
Shit, I can't. My cousin thinks I'm a total gentleman. If I ask, I'll look like some creep.
他想认识她，又怕开口时在妹妹面前显得太着急。可以给他一句跟桌游有关的开场，也可以建议他缓一缓，等自己觉得合适再开口。
He wants to get to know her, but he's afraid of looking too eager in front of his cousin. Give him an opening about the game, or give him time to ask when it feels right.

reply: 你之前提过她可能是你妹妹的同桌。要是你妹妹确实认识她，可以请她先问问，对方愿不愿意加个微信。
You mentioned she might be your cousin's deskmate. If your cousin does know her, you can ask her to check if she'd be up for adding you on WeChat.
可以直接问她一句「下次再玩还想叫你，能加个微信吗？」你把想继续一起玩的意思说清楚，她也好当面答。
You can ask her directly: “I'd love to invite you next time we play. Can I add you on WeChat?” It gives her a clear reason and lets her answer in person.
你要是现在开口反而不自在，可以先算了。今天刚认识，以后有机会一起玩，再问也来得及。
If asking now would feel all wrong, leave it for today. You just met. If you play together again, you can always ask then.

lines: 好！我就假装帮我舍友要吧，看我妹啥反应，不行就算了
Okay! I'll pretend I'm asking for my roommate and see how my cousin reacts. If it's weird I'll drop it.
他想假装替舍友问，给自己留个台阶。可以理解他怕难为情，但最好把是谁想加说清楚，省得妹妹真把话传岔。
He's using his roommate as cover in case it gets awkward. I get why he's embarrassed, but he'd better be clear about who wants to add her, or his cousin could pass on the wrong message.

reply: 你要是怕开口，可以让你妹先帮你问一声。不过最好说是你自己想加，不然她真告诉对方是你舍友想认识她，后面你反而得解释。
If asking feels awkward, you can have your cousin check with her. I'd tell your cousin it's you, though. If she tells the girl your roommate wants to meet her, you'll just have to explain it later.

lines: 哎你说的有道理，而且估计那个女生可能本来就比较开朗吧，我可能就是多想了
Yeah, you've got a point. She's probably just an outgoing person anyway. Maybe I read too much into it.
他现在更愿意把她的热情理解成性格好，也决定先不问。可以回应他的失落，让他按自己的节奏结束这次聚会。
He's more inclined to put her warmth down to her personality now, and he's decided to leave it. Acknowledge the disappointment and let the meetup end at his pace.

reply: 有可能。你今天觉得她挺好相处，这个感受是真的。至于下次有没有机会再认识，留到下次一起玩再看吧。
Could be. You did find her easy to get along with, and that feeling was real. If you get another chance to play together, see where it goes then.

lines: 唉，行吧，那就当我多想了，不问不问了，就当认识个牌友，回家回家。
Ah, okay. Guess I read too much into it. I'm not asking, I'm not asking. Just someone to play cards with. Time to go home.
他已经决定不问，准备回家。可以回应他把对方当牌友的决定，不用再替他设想另一种结果。
He's decided not to ask and is getting ready to leave. Let him leave it at having met someone to play cards with.

thought: Let him call it a day
reply: 那今天就先到这儿。有人愿意接你的话，这局玩得也挺有意思。下次碰见，打个招呼就好。
That's a good place to leave it for today. Someone picked up on what you were saying, and it made the game fun. If you run into her again, you can just say hi.

lines: 我今天玩桌游遇到个男的，是我同桌的表哥
I met a guy at board games today. He's my deskmate's older cousin.
她特地说起今天遇到的男生，还交代了两人的关系。可以问问她为什么想到提他，先听她自己的感受。
She made a point of bringing up a guy she met and explained how they're connected. I can ask what made her think of him and hear her out first.

reply: 原来是你同桌的表哥。你今天跟他说上话了吗？他给你的第一印象怎么样？
Oh, your deskmate's older cousin. Did you get to talk to him today? What was your first impression?

lines: 哎呀，就是我感觉他性格还挺好的， 但是我没他微信咋办
So, I thought he seemed really nice. But I don't have his WeChat. What do I do?
她觉得对方性格好，也想继续认识他。她刚说那是同桌的表哥，可以建议先请同桌问问对方愿不愿意加。
She liked his personality and wants to know him better. She just said he's her deskmate's older cousin. She could have her deskmate check if he wants to add her.

thought: 请同桌问问他愿不愿意
reply: 可以找你同桌问一声，请她先问她表哥愿不愿意加。要是他也愿意，你们就有个机会继续聊今天的桌游。
Ask your deskmate if she'd check whether her cousin wants to add you. If he does, the game today gives you something to talk about.

lines: 但是我不好意思给她说啊，之前谈的前男友太脑残她劝我我没听，我怕她又要说我了
But I'd feel so awkward asking her. My ex was a complete idiot. She warned me and I didn't listen. What if she gives me a hard time again?
她怕同桌把这次认识新人和上次恋爱联系起来。可以给她一句只谈桌游、先问能不能介绍的开场，也可以让她先放下。
She's afraid her deskmate will bring up her last relationship. I can give her an opening about playing again and getting introduced, or let her set it aside.

reply: 可以说「今天跟你表哥玩得挺开心，下次组局还想叫他。你能不能先问问他愿不愿意加个微信？」你只是想认识他，先把这件事说清楚就行。

Try: “I had fun playing with your cousin today. I'd like to invite him next time. Could you ask if he'd be up for adding me on WeChat?” You're just asking to get to know him. That's all you need to say.
如果你现在一开口就得防着被说，今天也可以先放一放。刚见了一面，你可以等自己真想联系他时再问。
If you feel like you'd have to brace for a lecture just to ask, you can let it sit today. You've met him once. You can wait until you really feel like reaching out.

lines: 可以可以，你太聪明了！我去问
Yeah, that'll work. You're so smart! I'll ask her.
她愿意去问了。接下来需要让同桌先征求表哥的意见，可以确认这一步，让她不用现在就准备加上后要聊什么。
She's going to ask. Her deskmate needs to check with him first. I can confirm that step so she doesn't feel like she has to plan what to say after they add each other.

reply: 嗯，你可以先这么开口。等散场你有机会单独跟她说，再问就行。
Yep, that's a good way to start. Ask her when you get a chance to talk to her alone after the game.

lines: 嗯…那算了，不问了，万一她再唠叨我我更烦，就这样吧。
Hmm… forget it. I won't ask. If she starts lecturing me again I'll just get annoyed. Let's leave it.
她想到同桌可能又说起前任，就决定不问了。可以让她按自己的决定收尾，不用反复说服她。
Thinking about another conversation about her ex has put her off asking. Let her call it without making a case for it again.

reply: 那今天就先不问。觉得他不错，和现在就得加微信，是两件可以分开想的事。
Okay, leave it for today. You can think he seems nice and decide to add him on WeChat some other time.

lines: 我直接问了，说下次玩还想叫她。她说可以加。她喊她同桌帮忙推一下，结果喊的是我妹。靠，问之前还觉得巨尴尬。

I asked her myself. Said I'd like to invite her next time we play. She said I could add her. Then she asked her deskmate to send over her contact, and it was my cousin she called over. Damn, I thought it was gonna be so awkward before I asked.
他当面问了，对方答应加微信，随后由她的同桌推联系方式。可以肯定他已经把最难开口的一句说了，接下来等对方发过来就好。
He asked her himself and she said yes. Now her deskmate will share the contact. He's already said the hardest part. All he has to do now is wait for it to come through.

reply: 你当面问了，她也答应了。等你妹把微信推过来就行。真说出来以后，是不是比你刚才想的简单一点？
You asked her in person and she said yes. Now you just need your cousin to send you her WeChat contact. Was saying it out loud a little easier than you thought?

lines: 我刚才还在想要不要问呢，他直接走过来，说下次玩还想叫我，问能不能加微信。我说可以，就叫我同桌帮我推一下。哎，省我开口了。

I was still wondering if I should ask, and he just came over. Said he'd like to invite me next time they play and asked if he could add me on WeChat. I said sure and asked my deskmate to send over my contact. Whew, saved me having to ask.
他已经当面问过，她也答应了。现在只等同桌转发联系方式，可以回应她松了口气。
He's already asked in person and she's said yes. Now she's just waiting for her deskmate to share the contact. I can respond to how relieved she is.

reply: 嗯，你们当面说好了。等你同桌把微信推过去，想聊的时候就能直接聊了。
Yep, you worked it out in person. Once your deskmate sends over your WeChat contact, you two can talk whenever you feel like it.

lines: 我妹说，那女生也找她要过我微信！那不就是我俩想到一块去了？现在加上了，我第一句发啥啊，别显得我准备半天似的。

My cousin says that girl asked her for my WeChat too! So we were both thinking the same thing? We've added each other now. What do I send first? I don't want it to sound like I've been working on it all day.
两人都问过联系方式，他兴奋，也怕第一句显得太刻意。可以用桌游做开头，有共同话题，对方也容易接。
They both asked for each other's contact. He's excited, but doesn't want to sound scripted. They already have board games in common. That's an easy opening for her to answer.

reply: 可以问一句「嗨，上次桌游坐你旁边的，还记得我吗？」你们已经见过了，提那天的事就行，不用再找个特别的由头。
You could send, “Hey, I sat next to you at board games. Remember me?” You've already met. You can just bring up that day.

lines: 微信到手了，我妹牵的线。上次桌游我还输给她了。我对着输入框抠半天了，第一句咋整？总不能发个你好吧，像上门推销的。

Got her WeChat. My cousin put us in touch. She beat me at board games last time. I've been staring at the text box forever. What's my first line? I can't just say hello. I'll sound like a door-to-door salesman.
联系方式有了，他卡在怎样开始。可以顺着他对桌游的印象给一句自嘲式开场，省去正式自我介绍的压力。
He has her contact but is stuck on how to begin. He can joke about losing the game and skip the formal introduction.

reply: 你可以发「嗨，那天桌游输给你的那个，还记得吗？」有见过面的事可以聊，一句够用了。
You could send, “Hey, I'm the guy you beat at board games. Remember me?” You've already met, so one line is plenty.

lines: 反转了兄弟，我还没想好咋开口呢，她先加我了！是不是我妹跟她说啥了？你说她这啥意思啊？
Plot twist, dude. I hadn't even figured out how to ask and she added me first! You think my cousin said something to her? What do you think it means?
她主动加了好友，他却开始猜妹妹有没有说过什么。能确定的是他们已经加上了，可以建议先打招呼，等她实际回应。
She added him first and now he's guessing what his cousin said. What he knows is that they're connected. He can say hi and see how she really responds.

thought: Say hi and see what happens
reply: 至少她愿意加你。你可以先发「嗨，上次桌游玩得挺开心的」。她为什么先加，等你们聊几句可能就明白了。
She wanted to add you, at least. You can start with, “Hey, I had fun playing board games the other day.” You might get a better sense of why she added you once you talk.

lines: 加上了，我妹给推的。我刚才当面都敢问，怎么打个招呼又卡住了。你说第一句咋发？
We're connected. My cousin sent her contact over. I managed to ask in person, so why am I freezing up just saying hi? What should I send first?
他当面问到了联系方式，第一句反倒有点紧张。可以从两人一起玩的桌游开口。
He managed to ask in person, but sending the first message makes him nervous. He can start with the game they played together.

reply: 可以问一句「嗨，上次桌游坐你旁边的，还记得我吗？」你们已经见过了，提那天的事就行，不用再找个特别的由头。
You could send, “Hey, I sat next to you at board games. Remember me?” You've already met. You can just bring up that day.

lines: 想了想，你给的那句我有点发不出来。我自己写了个：『hi，上次桌游坐你旁边的，还记得我不？提前说一声，我作息特别老年，十一点必睡』。咋样，会不会有点傻？

I thought about it and I don't think I can send your line. I wrote one myself: “hi, I sat next to you at board games. Remember me? Fair warning, I keep old people hours. Asleep by eleven, no exceptions.” How's that? Too dumb?
他改成了自己会说的话，还提了十一点睡觉。开头能让对方想起见面的情景，后半句也留了能接的话题。
He's rewritten it in his own words and mentioned going to bed at eleven. The first part reminds her how they met, and the second gives her something to respond to.

reply: 挺像你会说的话。「还记得我不」好接，十一点必睡也有点好笑。就照这句发吧。
That sounds like you. “Remember me?” is easy to answer, and the eleven o'clock rule is kind of funny. Send it as it is.

lines: 我同桌说，她表哥也找她要过我微信。等于我俩互相问了一遍？刚加上，他就发：『hi，上次桌游坐你旁边的，还记得我不？提前说一声，我作息特别老年，十一点必睡』。这人怎么连睡觉时间都一起报了，我咋回啊？

My deskmate says her cousin asked for my WeChat too. So we both asked her? We just added each other and he sent, “hi, I sat next to you at board games. Remember me? Fair warning, I keep old people hours. Asleep by eleven, no exceptions.” Why is he giving me his bedtime right off the bat? How do I answer?
她发现对方也主动问过联系方式，对他的开场觉得好笑。可以给一句轻松的回复，既回答还记不记得，也顺着十一点睡觉开个玩笑。
She found out he asked for her contact too. His opening made her laugh. She can answer his question and tease him about going to bed at eleven.

thought: Play along with the bedtime joke
reply: 回「记得，你也要到点睡了」就挺自然。你记得他，也能逗他一句，后面看你们聊到什么。
“I remember. It's almost your bedtime, too” sounds natural. It tells him you remember and lets you tease him a little. See where the conversation goes from there.

lines: 磨半天终于把他加上了，开场白还没憋出来呢，他先发来了：『hi，上次桌游坐你旁边的，还记得我不？提前说一声，我作息特别老年，十一点必睡』。行吧，省得我想了。咋接？

I finally added him after putting it off forever. I hadn't even come up with an opening when he sent, “hi, I sat next to you at board games. Remember me? Fair warning, I keep old people hours. Asleep by eleven, no exceptions.” Well, that saves me the trouble. What do I say?
她先加了好友，又因为对方先开口松了口气。对方已经提供了见面和睡觉两个话题，可以直接接他的句子。
She added him first and is relieved he got the conversation going. He's given her both the game and his bedtime to talk about. She can just pick up where he left off.

reply: 可以回「记得，你也要到点睡了」。他给了现成的话题，你按平时说话的样子接一句就行。
You could say, “I remember. It's almost your bedtime, too.” He's given you something to talk about. Just say it the way you normally would.

lines: 我同桌那个表哥加我了。我刚点通过，他消息就来了：『hi，上次桌游坐你旁边的，还记得我不？提前说一声，我作息特别老年，十一点必睡』。这人是有多着急，哈哈。回啥好啊？

My deskmate's cousin added me. I hit accept and his message came right in: “hi, I sat next to you at board games. Remember me? Fair warning, I keep old people hours. Asleep by eleven, no exceptions.” Someone's in a hurry, haha. What should I say?
他发消息的速度让她觉得好笑，她也在考虑怎么回应。可以给一句低压力的答复，聊天要不要继续，等她自己感受。
How fast he messaged made her laugh. She's wondering how to answer. Give her an easy reply and leave it to her how much she wants to keep talking.

thought: Reply and see how it goes
reply: 可以回「记得，你也要到点睡了」。顺着他的梗逗一句就行，接下来想聊多少，看你自己舒服不舒服。
You could say, “I remember. It's almost your bedtime, too.” Tease him a little about the bedtime thing. Then keep talking as long as you feel like it.

lines: 那个刚才当面问我的男生，加上了。我同桌把我微信推给他了。他刚发：『hi，上次桌游坐你旁边的，还记得我不？提前说一声，我作息特别老年，十一点必睡』。这人怎么连睡觉时间都一起报了，我咋回啊？

The guy who asked me in person just added me. My deskmate sent him my WeChat. He just wrote, “hi, I sat next to you at board games. Remember me? Fair warning, I keep old people hours. Asleep by eleven, no exceptions.” Why is he giving me his bedtime right off the bat? How do I answer?
她已经收到他的第一条消息，觉得开场好笑。可以给一句轻松的回复，顺着十一点睡觉开个玩笑。
She's got his first message and thinks it's funny. She can reply lightly and tease him about going to bed at eleven.

thought: Play along with the bedtime joke
reply: 回「记得，你也要到点睡了」就挺自然。你记得他，也能逗他一句，后面看你们聊到什么。
“I remember. It's almost your bedtime, too” sounds natural. It tells him you remember and lets you tease him a little. See where the conversation goes from there.

lines: 发了！四十来分钟才回，就一句『记得，你也要到点睡了』。我看了半天，这算是想聊还是在跟我说晚安啊？
Sent it! Took her like forty minutes to reply, and all she said was “I remember. It's almost your bedtime, too.” I've been looking at it forever. Is she trying to chat or saying good night?
他在用等待的时间猜对方态度。原话既回应了自我介绍，也顺着他提到了睡觉。可以自然道晚安，也可以用桌游接一句。
He's reading her attitude into how long she took to answer. She answered his question and picked up on his bedtime joke. He can say good night or keep talking about board games.

reply: 她至少接住了你十一点睡觉的梗，四十分钟说明不了更多。你可以回「还没到点呢，我先去洗漱了，晚安」。第一晚聊到这儿也挺好。

She got your joke about going to bed at eleven. Forty minutes doesn't tell you much else. You can say, “Not bedtime yet. I'm gonna get ready for bed, though. Good night.” That's a fine place to end the first night.
要是还想聊，就回「还早呢。桌游我输你的那局还没扳回来，什么时候再战？」有个她能接的话题，聊到哪算哪。
If you want to keep talking, try, “Still early. I haven't made up for losing to you at board games. When's the rematch?” It gives her something to answer. See where it goes.

lines: 昨晚听你的，道了晚安就真睡了，还赶在十一点前，破天荒。今早她又找我聊了两句。也没啥事，就是我还想跟她多说会儿，老想点开那个框。

I took your advice last night. Said good night and actually went to bed. Before eleven, even. There's a first. She messaged me again this morning. It was nothing big. I just wanted to talk more and keep opening the chat.
道晚安之后，女生仍主动联系。他惦记的是没聊够，可以肯定这个感受，同时用今早的情况帮他放下对昨晚收尾的顾虑。
She reached out after he said good night. He wishes they'd talked longer. I can acknowledge that and point to this morning so he doesn't have to worry about how he left things last night.

thought: 昨晚收得早，今天还能聊
reply: 昨晚那句晚安没把话聊死，今早她还来找你了。想再多聊两句很正常，有事想跟她说的时候再发就行。
Saying good night didn't end the conversation for good. She came back this morning. Of course you want to talk a little more. Send something the next time you've got something to say.

lines: 昨晚顺着翻盘那个梗还真聊起来了，聊到十一点多。十一点必睡，当天就倒了，笑死。她后来跟我说晚安。结果今天到现在一条没有……我昨晚是不是聊太多了？

The rematch joke actually got us talking last night, past eleven. Asleep by eleven, no exceptions, and I blew it on day one lol. She said good night later. Now it's been all day and nothing… Did I talk too much last night?
昨晚聊得投入，今天暂时安静，他把两件事联系起来了。先指出昨晚有正常收尾，今天的沉默还不足以判断她的态度。
The conversation went well last night and today has been quiet. He's connecting the two. They said good night normally. Today's silence doesn't tell him how she feels.

thought: Take his eyes off the chat
reply: 你们昨晚聊得起来，最后也正常道了晚安。今天还没消息，先别拿它给昨晚判分。做点自己的事，晚些再看。
You got talking last night and said good night like normal. She hasn't messaged yet today. You don't have to use that to grade last night. Do something of your own for now and check later.

lines: 昨晚我先回了句『记得，你也要到点睡了』，本来就随口一逗。这两天聊下来比我想的舒服，有话就接，我没回他也没催。今天他发了几条，我忙着还没仔细回。晚上有空了，我去找他唠两句。

Last night I just said “I remember. It's almost your bedtime, too” to tease him. Talking these last couple of days has been easier than I expected. We pick up when there's something to say, and he doesn't chase me if I don't answer. He sent a few things today and I've been too busy to really reply. I'll go chat a little tonight when I have time.
她觉得这几次聊天没有催促，也有了主动继续聊的意愿。可以肯定她想联系就去联系，按她现在有空的节奏开始。
She hasn't felt rushed in these conversations and feels like reaching out herself. She can start when she has time, at a pace that feels good to her.

thought: 顺着她主动联系的念头
reply: 你现在有空，也有话想跟他说，就去聊两句吧。前面的消息挑一个你真想接的回，剩下的不用补作业。
If you've got a minute now and feel like talking to him, go ahead. Pick whichever earlier message you actually want to answer. The rest isn't homework.

lines: 刚聊完！她晚上主动来找我了，一聊就一个多钟头。其实也没啥大事，东一句西一句的，还挺舒服。我白天还在那儿瞎想，现在感觉也不用老算她多久回了。

Just finished talking! She messaged me first tonight and we talked for over an hour. Nothing big, just this and that. It felt pretty easy. I was overthinking it all day. Now I feel like I don't have to keep timing her replies.
他收到女生的主动联系，注意力从回复间隔回到了聊天本身。可以回应这次体验，让他把舒服的来往当作参考。
She reached out first. He's paying attention to the chat instead of the gaps between replies. I can respond to that and help him use the way it felt as a reference.

reply: 你开始在意的是这一个钟头聊得舒不舒服了。能东一句西一句聊这么久，听着挺自在。下次有想说的话，再接着聊就行。
Now you're thinking about how that hour felt. An hour of talking about whatever comes up sounds pretty easy. Next time you've got something to say, you can just pick up from there.

lines: 他回消息也太勤快了……我下班一看攒了一堆。不是不想理他，就是累，连回啥都懒得想。对了，他头像是只小熊，看着挺憨。哎，今晚我就想回个什么，让他知道我看见了。

He replies so much… I got off work and there was a whole pile of messages. I do want to talk to him, I'm just tired. I can't even be bothered thinking of what to say. Oh, his profile pic is a bear. Looks kind of goofy. Anyway, tonight I just want to send something so he knows I saw them.
她看见了消息，也想让对方知道，但下班后没有精力长聊。可以建议直接说明今天很累，或用一个表示累了的表情先回应。
She wants him to know she saw the messages, but doesn't have the energy for a long conversation after work. She could tell him she's tired or send a reaction that says it for her.

reply: 可以回「下班瘫了，今天回不动了」。他知道你在休息，你也不用边累边想怎么把每条都回得有意思。
Try, “I got home from work and I'm wiped. Don't have it in me to reply tonight.” Then he knows you're resting, and you don't have to make every answer interesting when you're exhausted.
懒得打字就丢个摊倒的表情，让他知道你看见了。想好好聊的话，等有精神的时候再聊。
If typing sounds like too much, send a sticker of someone flopping over so he knows you saw it. You can talk properly when you have the energy.

lines: 我真照你说的说累了。结果他秒回一大段，什么『好好休息』『别太拼』『记得吃晚饭』……排比句都出来了。我本来就回不动，看见那一大段更不知道说啥，就回了个嗯。我是不是有点不知好歹？

I did what you said and told him I was tired. He sent me a whole paragraph instantly. “Get some rest,” “don't push yourself,” “remember to eat dinner”… He was practically writing poetry. I already had no energy to reply, and after all that I had even less idea what to say. I just went “mm.” Am I being ungrateful?
她直说累了，对方给了很多关心，她反而一时不知道怎么接。可以肯定她已经回应过，接不动时先休息，也不必现在评价这份关心。
She told him she was tired and got a lot of care back. She didn't know how to answer it all. She's answered him already. She can rest without having to decide how she feels about it now.

reply: 你已经跟他说今天很累了，回个「嗯」也够了。他想关心你，你现在接不动，两件事都说得通。先歇会儿，明天有精神再聊。

You already told him you were tired. An “mm” is enough. He wanted to look after you, and you didn't have it in you to keep talking. Both make sense. Get some rest and talk tomorrow if you're up for it.

lines: 丢了个摊倒的表情过去，他正经回我『你早点休息』，还带了个他自己的表情包，土得掉渣。就是……有点可爱。算了，我洗漱去了。
I sent him a sticker of someone flopping over and he seriously wrote “Get some rest,” with his own sticker. It was so corny. It was also… kinda cute. Whatever, I'm getting ready for bed.
她用一个表情回应了消息，对方也顺着聊了两句。她觉得那份认真有点可爱，现在想收尾，可以轻松接一句。
She sent a sticker and he answered in his own way. She found his earnestness kind of cute. She's wrapping up, so something light is enough.

reply: 土得可爱也是一种可爱。今天回到这儿就挺好，去洗漱吧。
Corny cute is still cute. That's a good place to leave it tonight. Go get ready for bed.

lines: 又聊了一个礼拜。她回得慢但都会回，我好像也习惯了。今天她在家加班，还给我发了张照片，配一个『困』。她的猫踩着键盘抢镜，叫煤球，特别敬业。你说她这算不算有点把我当自己人了？

We've been talking for another week. She takes a while to reply, but she always does. I think I'm used to it now. She was working late at home today and sent me a pic with “sleepy.” Her cat was stepping all over the keyboard, stealing the shot. His name's Coalball. Very dedicated. You think this means she sees me as one of her people now?
她主动分享加班和猫的照片。他把稳定的来往理解成亲近，可以肯定这个具体变化，再建议顺着她发来的内容回应。
She sent him a casual photo of herself working late and her cat. He reads their steady contact as closeness. I can point to the specific change and suggest answering what she sent.

reply: 她愿意把这种随手拍的日常发给你，至少跟你聊天是自在的。可以回一句「煤球今天也加班啊」，再让她忙完早点歇。先聊这张照片就挺好。

She's comfortable enough to send you a random photo from her day. You could say, “Coalball putting in overtime too?” and tell her to get some rest when she's done. The photo's enough to talk about for now.

memories.label: 都会回
memories.name: Always replies
quote: 她回得慢但都会回
She takes a while to reply, but she always does

lines: 我现在一天能给她发八百条『在干嘛』。她有时候隔俩小时才回，我就又点开那个框看，明明啥都没响。客观说，我是不是有点上头？

At this point I send her “what are you up to” eight hundred times a day. Sometimes she takes two hours to reply and I keep opening the chat when I know my phone hasn't gone off. Objectively, am I getting a little carried away?
他开始留意自己的消息频率，也发现等待让他不安。可以试着少发重复问候，或保留自然分享，同时给对方留出回话的时间。
He's noticed how often he's messaging and how anxious he gets waiting. He can cut back on repeated check-ins, or keep sending things naturally and leave her time to answer.

reply: 有点，但你已经发现自己在等什么了。今天试试少发几次「在干嘛」，真有事想分享再发，看看空下来的时候你是什么感觉。

A little. You've noticed what you're waiting for, though. Try sending “what are you up to” fewer times today. If you've got something you really want to share, send that, and see how you feel in between.
想跟她说话很正常。碰到好玩的就发一条，她忙的时候先去做你的事，等她有空再接着聊。
It's normal to want to talk to her. Send something when you come across something fun. When she's busy, go do your own thing and pick up again when she's free.

lines: 今天试着少发了，话打了删删了打，最后就发了句晚安。她回得跟平时一样，也没问我咋这么安静……我感觉我在演一个淡定的人。

I tried sending less today. Kept typing and deleting and all I sent in the end was good night. She replied like usual. Didn't even ask why I was so quiet… I feel like I'm doing an impression of someone who's chill.
他减少了发消息的次数，对方的回复没有明显变化。他仍然不舒服，可以帮他区分想聊的心情和刻意压住自己的做法。
He's sent fewer messages and her replies haven't changed much. He's still uneasy. I can help him separate wanting to talk from making himself hold it in.

thought: 让他留点自己舒服的节奏
Find a pace he can live with
reply: 少发一天也会难受，毕竟你原本就想找她说话。真有事想分享，可以照常发，没必要把自己练成一个从来不主动的人。
Even one day of sending less can feel rough when what you really want is to talk to her. If you've got something to share, go ahead. You don't have to train yourself to never start a conversation.

lines: 今天还是想找她就找了，发了好几回。她有时候一个『哈哈哈』隔俩小时才来。我有一阵真像在对着屏幕自己跟自己聊天，笑死。
Today I still messaged her whenever I felt like it. A bunch of times. Sometimes it takes two hours to get a “hahaha.” For a while I really felt like I was just talking to myself through a screen lol.
他继续主动联系，回复的节奏还是不同。现在已经有了一段日常往来，可以建议约一次见面，让他看看两人当面相处的感觉。
He kept reaching out and their reply speeds still differ. They've been talking for a while now. Meeting in person would give him a chance to see what being together feels like.

reply: 隔着屏幕，有时候只能等她有空。你们已经聊了一阵了，可以问问她哪天愿意出来吃个饭，当面相处一会儿，可能比来回猜回复轻松。

Over text, sometimes all you can do is wait until she's free. You've been talking for a while. You could ask if she'd like to grab dinner sometime. Being together might feel easier than guessing at replies.

lines: 今天还是这样，不找吧心里老惦记，找吧又怕她嫌烦。线上聊得再欢，她一忙我就在这儿干等着。咋整啊？

Same today. If I don't message her, I keep thinking about it. If I do, I worry I'm annoying her. However much fun we're having online, the minute she gets busy I'm just sitting here waiting. What do I do?
控制发消息的频率没有解决他的顾虑。他想要一次能专心相处的机会，可以把见面作为具体建议，让对方按自己的时间答复。
Sending fewer messages hasn't settled his worries. He wants time together where they can both be present. Suggest meeting and let her tell him when she's free.

reply: 可以试试约她吃个饭。你们聊了这么久，有机会当面说话，你也能看看自己跟她待一块是什么感觉。先问她哪天方便就好。
You could ask her to get dinner. You've been talking for a while. In person, you can see how it feels to spend time together. Just ask when she's free.

lines: 这一周多一直断断续续聊着。他今天突然夸我开朗，说『跟你聊天不累』。那是，我不在办公室他们都没那么热闹，周末也老有人叫我出去。他坐那儿话倒不多，手机上还天天找我。反正听他夸我还挺开心的，嘿嘿。

We've been chatting on and off for over a week. Today he suddenly said I'm outgoing and that “Talking to you never feels like work.” Well, yeah. The office is way quieter without me and people are always asking me out on weekends. He's quiet when he's sitting there in person, then on his phone he's messaging me every day. Anyway, it felt really good to hear him say it, heh.
她喜欢被他说聊天不累，也享受自己能让大家聊起来。可以回应这份开心，也可以借机问问，累的时候她更愿意怎么和人相处。
She liked hearing that talking to her feels easy and enjoys getting people talking. I can share in that or ask how she likes to be around people when she's worn out.

reply: 你确实喜欢跟人聊天，也能让场子热起来。他说跟你聊天不累，你听了开心也正常，有些夸奖好听就是因为对方说到了你喜欢自己的地方。

You really do like talking to people, and you get a room talking. It makes sense that hearing him say it's easy with you felt good. Some compliments land because someone notices something you already like about yourself.

thought: Ask who she turns to when tired
reply: 跟谁都能聊是你的长处。我还想问一个小问题，你累了、平时那股劲儿没了的时候，有没有谁是你还愿意单独找的？没想到也没关系。

Being able to talk to anyone is a strength. I've got one little question: when you're tired and don't have your usual energy, is there anybody you'd still want to talk to one-on-one? It's okay if no one comes to mind.

lines: 晚上跟闺蜜吃饭，不知道怎么又说起他了。我说有个闷葫芦天天找我聊天，她们立马开始起哄。我还说就是普通朋友啊，结果回家路上自己一直笑。烦死了。

I was having dinner with my best friends and somehow brought him up again. I said there was this quiet guy who messages me every day, and they immediately started teasing me. I kept saying we're just friends, then smiled all the way home. So annoying.
她嘴上坚持普通朋友，回家路上却还在笑。她来分享的是被说中心事的有趣，可以顺着玩笑回应，不替她确定两人的关系。
She insists they're just friends, but she was still smiling on the way home. She's sharing how funny it was to get called out. I can play along without deciding what they are for her.

reply: 你把人叫闷葫芦，还专门带去饭桌上讲，难怪她们起哄。先让你们当普通朋友吧，今天笑这一路也挺好。
You called him the quiet guy and still made a point of bringing him up at dinner. No wonder they teased you. We'll call you two just friends for now. A smile all the way home is pretty nice.

lines: 睡前又想了下你问的那个。还真想不出来。我累了就点个外卖，自己刷会儿手机，也不想找谁。明明平时跟谁都能聊，真想说点啥了好像又差一口气……说不上来，今晚有点怪怪的。

I thought about your question again before bed. I really can't think of anyone. When I'm tired I order delivery, scroll on my phone for a bit, and don't feel like talking to anybody. I can talk to anyone normally, but when I actually want to say something it feels like something's missing… I can't explain it. Tonight feels kind of weird.
她认真想了白天的问题，发现平时热闹和疲惫时想找谁是两回事。她还说不清这份失落，可以先回应她的发现，不急着建议她改变交友方式。
She thought about the question and realized being sociable isn't the same as having someone to turn to when she's tired. She can't quite name what's bothering her. Let her stay with what she noticed.

reply: 平时跟大家聊得来，和累的时候想自己待着，都很正常。你今天只是发现了自己有时会想跟谁更近一点。先把这句话留着，不用今晚就想出那个人是谁。

Getting on with everyone and wanting time alone when you're tired both make sense. Today you noticed that sometimes you want to feel a little closer to someone. You can sit with that for now. You don't have to know who it is tonight.

lines: 他今天问我家是哪儿的、家里都有谁，我顺手聊别的去了。他也没接着问。这点我还挺喜欢的，换个人一通问我早烦了。

He asked where my family was from today and who was in it. I just changed the subject, and he didn't keep asking. I liked that about him. If someone else started firing off questions I'd be annoyed already.
她觉得被尊重，因为把话题转开后对方没有追问。可以肯定具体的分寸感，不需要由这一次聊天判断两人整体相处得怎样。
She felt respected when he didn't press after she changed the subject. I can acknowledge what he did without drawing conclusions about the whole relationship from one chat.

reply: 他看你没接那个话题，也就跟着聊别的了。你喜欢这种自在挺正常，家里的事什么时候想说，由你决定。
He saw you didn't pick up that topic and followed you onto the next one. It makes sense that felt easy. You get to decide when you want to talk about your family.

lines: 行，听人劝吃饱饭。我想约她周六出来吃个饭。上次桌游我还输给她了。直接问周六有空吗，会不会显得有点猴急？
Okay, okay, I'll take the advice. I want to ask her to dinner Saturday. She beat me at board games last time. If I just ask if she's free Saturday, will I look like I'm rushing it?
他已经决定约饭，想把邀请说得自然。可以用两人都知道的桌游输赢作由头，给出具体时间，让她有余地答复。
He's decided to ask her to dinner and wants it to feel natural. He can use the game they both remember, name a day, and leave her room to answer.

thought: Ask her out through the game
reply: 可以发「周六晚上有空吗，桌游输你的局还没讨回来，请你吃个饭」。约什么、哪天约都清楚，她也可以按自己的安排回你。

Try, “Are you free Saturday night? I still haven't gotten you back for beating me at board games. Let me take you to dinner.” She knows what you're asking and when, and can answer based on her own plans.

lines: 他问我『周六晚上有空吗，桌游输你的局还没讨回来，请你吃个饭』。我答应了，还挺会找台阶的。我同桌就是他表妹，兜了一圈还真约上了。就是明天项目有个节点，搞不好得加班。要真累成那样我也不想临时鸽他。还有，见面我要注意啥吗？

He asked, “Are you free Saturday night? I still haven't gotten you back for beating me at board games. Let me take you to dinner.” I said yes. Smooth excuse, actually. My deskmate is his cousin. All that going around and now we're really meeting up. Only thing is we've got a project deadline tomorrow and I might have to work late. If I'm that wiped out, I don't want to cancel on him last minute. Also, anything I should keep in mind when I see him?
她已经答应见面，也想到工作可能影响安排。可以给一个轻松的见面建议，再提醒如果时间有变，早点告诉对方。
She's already agreed to meet him and realizes work could affect the plan. Keep the advice about meeting simple, and remind her to let him know early if the timing changes.

thought: 让她按平时相处，有变提前说
Keep it natural and flag changes early
reply: 见面就聊你们平时会聊的事，桌游都打过了，不用专门准备话题。要是明天忙完发现周六实在不行，提前告诉他，再提个你能去的时间。

Talk about whatever you usually talk about. You've already played board games together. No need to prepare topics. If work makes Saturday impossible, tell him in advance and suggest a time you can do.

memories.label: 同桌是表妹
memories.name: Deskmate is his cousin
quote: 我同桌就是他表妹
My deskmate is his cousin

lines: 她说周六来不了了，项目临时有个节点，问改周日行不行。还发了个不好意思的表情。我知道她说了周日，但我还是有点不得劲。会不会其实不想来啊？

She can't come Saturday. Something came up on her project and she asked if Sunday works. She sent a little sorry sticker, too. I know she said Sunday, but it still feels off. What if she just doesn't want to come?
原来的约定改了，他有些失落。她给出了具体的替代日期，这能回应他担心约会取消的问题，仍无法从一句话确定她的心情。
The change disappointed him. She offered a specific day instead. That helps with his fear it's off entirely, but a message can't tell him how she feels.

reply: 你本来在等周六，失落也正常。她主动提了周日，目前你们还有见面的安排。可以回「行，周日，你忙你的」，先把这次改期接下来。

You were looking forward to Saturday. It makes sense you're disappointed. She suggested Sunday herself, so you're still set to meet. You can answer, “Okay, Sunday. Do what you need to do,” and take it from there.

lines: 乌鸦嘴，项目真炸了。周六去不了，我跟他说改周日行不行。他就回了句『行，周日，你忙你的』。我看了好几遍，怎么有点像不高兴？

I totally jinxed it. The project blew up. Saturday's out, so I asked if Sunday would work. All he wrote was “Okay, Sunday. Do what you need to do.” I've read it over and over. Doesn't he sound kind of upset?
他同意改到周日，回复短，她担心改期让他失望。情绪还无法确认，可以建议她补一句自己仍期待见面，让对方知道这次变动是工作所致。
He agreed to Sunday in a short reply. She's worried the change disappointed him. I can't tell how he's feeling. She could add that she's still looking forward to it, so he knows it was about work.

thought: Say she's still looking forward to it
reply: 他答应周日了，单看这句话还看不出有多介意。你要是也期待见面，可以补一句「周日见啊，我还是挺想去的」。事情变了，把你在意的部分说清楚就好。

He agreed to Sunday. That one line doesn't tell you how put out he is. If you're looking forward to it, say, “See you Sunday. I still really want to go.” The plans changed. You can tell him the part that matters to you.

lines: 见完了！吃饭散步聊了三个多小时，临走还拍了张合照。她问我下次想吃啥，说她想吃烤肉，下回带我吃。吃饭时她回了好几条工作消息，我坐那儿有点不知道干啥。还有个事，我跟她说，有次她半天没回，我半夜还刷她朋友圈，看她睡了没。她笑了下，说『你想得可真多』。我这话是不是说多了？

Just got back! We ate and walked and talked for over three hours. Took a photo together before we left. She asked what I wanted to eat next time. She said she was craving barbecue and would take me next time. She answered a few work messages over dinner and I just sat there not knowing what to do. One other thing: I told her about the time she didn't reply for half a day and I was up at midnight scrolling through her Moments to see if she'd gone to bed. She laughed a little and said, “You really do overthink things.” Did I say too much?
他既高兴她主动提下次，又担心自己那句坦白让她不舒服。她回了工作消息，也有继续见面的表示。可以分别回应这两件事，先不替她解释那声笑。

He's happy she brought up a next time and worried his admission made her uncomfortable. She answered work messages and also suggested meeting again. I can address each without deciding what her laugh meant.

thought: 回应见面的好感和他的顾虑
Address the date and his worry
reply: 她主动提了下次吃烤肉，这个信号比你回想她笑得像不像介意更具体。回工作消息那几分钟，你坐着会尴尬也正常。至于那句「你想得可真多」，目前听不出她有多介意，下次相处时留意她怎么回应就好。

She brought up getting barbecue next time. That's more concrete than trying to remember how much her laugh sounded like it bothered her. Feeling awkward while she answered work messages makes sense. As for “You really do overthink things,” it's hard to tell how much it bothered her. See how she responds next time you're together.

memories.label: 想吃烤肉
memories.name: Craving barbecue
quote: 说她想吃烤肉
she was craving barbecue

lines: 吃完了！本来还怕见了尴尬，结果吃饭散步聊了三个多小时，临走还拍了张合照。饭吃到一半我还回了好几条工作消息，回完他也能接上。散步的时候他跟我说，有次我半天没回，他半夜还在刷我朋友圈，看我睡了没。我愣了一下，笑着说『你想得可真多』。不过我后来还在想，是不是家里给了特别多爱，才这么会关心人？吃啥逛啥他都听我的，也挺省心。

We just got done! I thought it might be awkward, but we ate and walked and talked for over three hours. Took a photo together before leaving. I answered a few work messages halfway through dinner, and he picked right back up when I was done. On the walk he told me about the time I didn't reply for half a day and he was up at midnight scrolling through my Moments to see if I'd gone to bed. I paused, then laughed and said, “You really do overthink things.” But later I wondered, did he grow up with a lot of love at home to be this good at looking after people? He went along with whatever I wanted to eat and wherever I wanted to go. It was pretty easy.
她觉得见面舒服，也把他的关注往关心上想。她听到半夜刷朋友圈时确实愣了一下。可以同时回应这两种感受，家庭情况要等他自己说。

She enjoyed their time and took his attention as caring. She did pause when she heard about him checking her Moments at midnight. I can acknowledge both feelings and leave his family for him to talk about.

thought: 让她保留开心和那一下意外
reply: 你们今天聊得来，临走还拍了照，难怪你心里挺开心的。听到他半夜还在刷你朋友圈，你也确实愣了一下。开心和有点意外可以同时有。至于他家里怎么样，等他自己讲，比你现在猜得准。

You got on well and took a photo together before leaving. Of course you're happy. Hearing he'd been checking your Moments at midnight did catch you off guard. You can feel happy and a little surprised at once. As for his family, you'll know more when he tells you himself.

memories.label: 半夜刷朋友圈
memories.name: Midnight on Moments
quote: 他半夜还在刷我朋友圈，看我睡了没
he was up at midnight scrolling through my Moments to see if I'd gone to bed

memories.label: 家里有爱
memories.name: Lots of love at home
quote: 是不是家里给了特别多爱，才这么会关心人
did he grow up with a lot of love at home to be this good at looking after people

lines: 睡前最后问一句。就这两周，我还有戏吧？我上次这么上心，还是给我表妹辅导作业的时候。
One last thing before bed. After these two weeks, I've got a shot, right? Last time I put this much effort into anything was helping my cousin with her homework.
他想知道这两周的来往有没有继续发展的可能。今天她和他聊了三个多小时，还主动提了下次吃烤肉。可以用今天的事回应他的担心。
He wants to know if these two weeks could lead somewhere. They talked for three hours today and she brought up going out for barbecue. I can answer with what did happen.

thought: 用已经发生的事给他判断
reply: 今天聊了三个多小时，她还提了下次一起吃烤肉，至少她愿意继续跟你见面。至于你们会不会谈恋爱，得等真的聊到这一步才知道。

You talked for over three hours and she brought up getting barbecue together next time. At the very least, she wants to see you again. You'll find out if you're going to date when the two of you actually talk about it.

lines: 躺下了又想起来，他啥都听我的，这点其实我有点介意。但跟他待着是真不用费脑子。前几天家里的事我没接着聊，他也就没问了。可能……我就是想跟一个相处起来不费劲的人待着吧。

I lay down and thought of this again. He leaves everything up to me, and it actually bothers me a little. But being with him takes no effort. The other day I didn't get into the family thing, and he didn't ask again. Maybe… I just want to be with someone who's easy to be around.
她喜欢不用费力维持气氛，也还没确定自己是否喜欢一直由她拿主意。可以把这两个感受分开回应，后面相处时再看她最在意哪一点。
She likes that she doesn't have to keep the conversation going herself. She's less sure she likes making every decision. I can address those separately and let her see which matters more over time.

thought: 分开说舒服和总要拿主意
reply: 你喜欢的是跟他待着不用撑场面，这点挺具体。至于去哪儿、吃什么老要你定，你要是哪次嫌累了，也可以跟他说让他挑一次。
You like that you don't have to work to keep things going around him. That's something specific. If you're tired of always picking where to go or what to eat, you can ask him to pick next time.

lines: 我想跟她表白。稿子打了删删了打，现在是『我挺喜欢你的，想跟你正经处对象，你考虑考虑』。读着怎么这么怪，你帮我改改。

I want to tell her I like her. I've typed and deleted it a bunch of times. Right now it's “I really like you and I'd like us to be in a serious relationship. Think it over.” Why does that sound so weird? Can you fix it?
他希望表达喜欢，又担心措辞生硬。「考虑考虑」听着像催人回一个决定。可以直接问是否交往，也可以先说感受，请她说说自己的想法。

He wants to say he likes her but the wording feels stiff. “Think it over” sounds like he's asking her to come back with a decision. He can ask her directly or say how he feels and ask what she thinks.

thought: 直接问她要不要在一起
Ask if she wants to go out
reply: 可以说「跟你待一块儿的时候我挺开心的。我喜欢你，想跟你谈恋爱。你愿意吗？」意思已经很清楚，问完就留点时间给她。
Try, “I'm really happy when I'm with you. I like you, and I want us to go out. Would you like that?” That's clear. Once you've asked, give her some time.

thought: 先说喜欢，听听她怎么想
Say how he feels and ask her
reply: 可以先说「跟你待一块的时候特别舒服，我可能有点喜欢你，你觉得呢？」先让她知道你的感受，她可以按自己的方式回答。
You could start, “I feel really at ease around you. I think I might have a thing for you. What do you think?” She'll know how you feel and can answer however she wants.

lines: 发了！就用你改的那句。发完我就想把手机扔了。她一会儿在输入，一会儿又没了，我盯得心脏一抽一抽的。你说这是在想怎么回，还是想拒绝我啊？

Sent it! The line you fixed. As soon as I sent it I wanted to throw my phone away. She'll be typing and then it goes away, then it's back. My heart keeps jumping watching it. Is she figuring out what to say, or how to turn me down?
他已经发出了直接问要不要在一起的话，现在把输入状态当成了答案的线索。能知道的只有她还没回，建议他离开屏幕一会儿，等实际回复。
He asked directly whether she'd go out with him. Now he's trying to read an answer into the typing indicator. All he knows is she hasn't answered. Suggest he step away until the reply comes.

thought: 先停下对输入状态的猜测
Stop reading into the typing dots
reply: 「正在输入」看不出她准备答应还是拒绝。你已经把想说的发过去了，先去洗把脸，让她有时间把自己的话写完。
“Typing” can't tell you whether she's going to say yes or no. You sent what you wanted to say. Go wash your face and give her time to finish writing.

lines: 你改的那句发了。我特别想撤回，又怕撤回更显得我有事。她要回一句『你说啥呢哈哈』，我下半辈子咋做人啊？
I sent the line you fixed. I really want to unsend it, but then I'll look even weirder. If she says “what are you talking about lol,” how do I show my face for the rest of my life?
他提前想象对方用玩笑带过，正在犹豫要不要撤回。可以说明他已经把感受说清楚，等对方实际回应后再决定怎么接。
He's imagining her laughing it off and thinking about unsending it. He's already said what he feels. He can decide how to respond after she actually answers.

reply: 你这句表达了喜欢，也给她留了说自己想法的空间。先别撤回，也不用替她写一条最尴尬的回复。等真的回了，再想怎么接。
You told her you like her and left room for her to say how she feels. Leave it there for now. You don't have to write the most awkward reply for her. When she really answers, decide what to say then.

lines: 他跟我表白了。说喜欢我，问我怎么想。我盯屏幕得有十分钟了。说不心动是假的，但我一想到真要谈了就怕，之前一认真就搞砸。你说我这种，能谈好吗？

He told me he likes me. Asked what I think. I've been staring at the screen for ten minutes. I'd be lying if I said I didn't feel something. But actually being in a relationship scares me. Last time I took it seriously I screwed it up. Do you think someone like me can make it work?
她对他有好感，也怕认真交往以后把事情搞砸。她需要的是眼下怎么回答，可以建议她把顾虑说清楚，也可以先从一句愿意试试开始。
She likes him and worries she'll mess things up once it's serious. She needs to know what to say right now. She can tell him what worries her or start with saying she wants to try.

thought: Say she likes him and is nervous
reply: 想试的话，可以把你现在会说的也告诉他：「我也想试试，只是我可能不太会谈恋爱，你多担待」。他能听见你的愿意，也知道你心里还有点没底。

If you want to try, tell him as much as you can say now: “I'd like to give it a try too. I just might not be very good at relationships, so bear with me.” He'll hear that you're willing and that you're still a little unsure.
可以先打一句「我们先试试」。你今天只需要告诉他现在的想法，剩下的话等你想说清楚了再补。
Start with, “Let's give it a try.” Today you only have to tell him how you feel right now. You can say more when you know what you want to say.

lines: 我把那句打出来了：『我也想试试，只是我可能不太会谈恋爱，你多担待』。打完又盯着看了半天。越看越觉得这话有点重，像把我自己交出去了。发还是不发，你帮我看看。

I typed it: “I'd like to give it a try too. I just might not be very good at relationships, so bear with me.” Then I stared at it for ages. The more I read it, the heavier it felt. It's like I'm handing myself over. Should I send it? Can you look?
她已经把愿意和顾虑都写出来，犹豫是因为这句话很坦白。可以帮她确认句子表达了现在的想法，把是否发送留给她。
She's written that she wants to try and that she's nervous. She's hesitating because it's honest. I can confirm it says what she feels and leave the decision to her.

thought: 确认她想说的都在里面
Check that it says what she means
reply: 这句已经把你想试试、又没那么有把握都说出来了。你如果想让他知道的就是这些，可以发。后面的事，等真的遇到了再一起说。
It says you want to try and that you're not entirely sure of yourself. If that's what you want him to know, you can send it. Whatever comes after, you can talk about it when it actually happens.

lines: 我按你说的先打了『我们先试试』，又给删了。就觉得少了点啥，好像现在不说，我以后搞砸了又得怪自己。也可能是我想太远了，他就是问我要不要试试。

I typed “Let's give it a try” like you said and deleted it. It feels like something's missing. If I don't say it now and mess things up later, I'll blame myself again. Or maybe I'm getting way ahead of myself. He just asked if I want to try.
简短的答复让她容易开口，但她仍想说明自己没把握。可以补上这层顾虑，让她按真正想表达的意思回复，不必预先为以后发生的事负责。
The short answer is easier to say, but she still wants him to know she's unsure. She can include that worry without taking responsibility in advance for whatever might happen.

thought: Include the part she cares about
reply: 你想让他知道你也会紧张，可以多说半句：「我也想试试，只是我可能不太会谈恋爱，你多担待」。说到你眼下有把握的地方就够了。

If you want him to know you're nervous too, give him that extra bit: “I'd like to give it a try too. I just might not be very good at relationships, so bear with me.” It's enough to say what you know right now.

lines: 她回了！！我以为凉了，结果她说『我也想试试，只是我可能不太会谈恋爱，你多担待』。我先回了三个感叹号。她这是答应了对吧？那个『只是』后面的是啥意思啊？

She replied!! I thought it was over, but she said “I'd like to give it a try too. I just might not be very good at relationships, so bear with me.” I sent back three exclamation points. That's a yes, right? What does the “I just” part mean?
对方愿意试着交往，也主动说了自己对恋爱有顾虑。他高兴之余想知道后半句是什么意思。可以先确认答复，再建议以后慢慢了解她具体担心什么。

She's willing to try a relationship and told him she has some worries about it. He's excited and wants to know what the second part means. Confirm the answer and suggest they learn what she's worried about as it comes up.

thought: Congratulate him and address her worry
reply: 是，她愿意和你试试，恭喜。后半句是在告诉你，她对怎么谈恋爱也没把握。以后遇到具体的事，你们可以再聊她需要什么、你又是怎么想的。

Yes, she wants to give it a try with you. Congratulations. The second part is her telling you she's not very sure of herself in relationships. As things come up, you can talk about what she needs and how you're feeling too.

memories.label: 不会谈恋爱
memories.name: Unsure about relationships
quote: 只是我可能不太会谈恋爱
I just might not be very good at relationships

lines: 发了！『我也想试试，只是我可能不太会谈恋爱，你多担待』。我手一直抖，跟考试交卷似的。他秒回了三个感叹号……好家伙。发出去那一下反倒没那么吓人了。

I sent it! “I'd like to give it a try too. I just might not be very good at relationships, so bear with me.” My hands were shaking the whole time, like turning in an exam. He instantly sent three exclamation points… wow. It wasn't nearly as scary once I hit send.
她发出了自己愿意试试的答复，也收到了对方的回应。她比发之前放松了，可以顺着这个开心的小插曲收尾，暂时不用讨论更远的事。
She sent her answer and got a reply. She's more relaxed than she was before sending. I can end on that little happy moment and leave the bigger conversation for later.

thought: 顺着她发出去后的轻松
reply: 三个感叹号，看来他刚才也没少等。你已经把最难开口的话发出去了，今天可以先开心一会儿。
Three exclamation points. Sounds like he was doing some waiting of his own. You've sent the hardest thing to say. It's okay to just be happy about it for a while.

lines: 昨晚她答应跟我在一起了。我睡前又看了两遍聊天，今天醒来还想看。我想发个朋友圈，用上次一起拍的照片。配什么啊，别太肉麻。

She said yes last night. I read the chat twice more before bed and wanted to read it again when I woke up. I want to post on Moments with the photo we took last time. What should I write? Nothing too cheesy.
用户刚确认恋爱关系，想公开这份喜悦，又不希望配文太肉麻。可以直接说出关系，也可以从以后一起吃饭入手，让照片表达剩下的意思。
The user just got into a relationship and wants people to know he's happy without getting sappy. He can say it directly or mention something small about eating together and let the photo do the rest.

reply: 照片已经有了，配文可以简单直接一点：终于可以光明正大叫她女朋友了。开心的事，不一定非要藏着说。
You've got the photo. Keep the caption simple: “Finally get to call her my girlfriend.” You're happy. It's okay to say it plainly.
可以配这句：以后不用天天一个人吃饭了。话不用说得很满，合照一放，大家就懂了。
Try: “Guess I don't have to eat alone every day anymore.” The photo will tell people the rest.

lines: 发了。我朋友说，憋这么久，终于让你等到了。我兄弟眼红了哈哈哈。
Posted it. My friend said, “You've been holding it in for ages. Finally got what you were waiting for.” My guy's jealous hahaha.
他发出动态后得到朋友的起哄，正借玩笑分享恋爱的开心。可以顺着回应，不必替他解释朋友的真实想法。
His friends are giving him a hard time in the comments, and he's sharing how happy he is through the joke. I can play along without deciding what they really think.

thought: 顺着他的得意开个玩笑
reply: 看出来了，你现在连被起哄都挺高兴。这条朋友圈值了。
Look at you, even happy to get teased. That post was worth it.

lines: 发了。我朋友评论，以前叫你吃饭，你可不是这么说的。我回他，你要是女的我也可以考虑考虑。他现在在群里骂我。
Posted it. My friend commented, “That's not what you said when I used to ask you to eat with me.” I said, “If you were a girl I'd consider it.” Now he's cussing me out in the group chat.
朋友的调侃让他继续开起玩笑，语气轻松，想分享发出官宣后的热闹。可以回应这个结果，不把玩笑当成需要处理的矛盾。
His friend's teasing turned into a joke between them. He's sharing the fun after posting. I can answer in the same spirit.

reply: 恋爱公开了，朋友也顺便逗到了。看起来今天的好心情还能撑很久。
You made it official and got to mess with your friend while you were at it. Looks like today's good mood is going to last.

lines: 我刚问她要不要庆祝一下。她问怎么庆祝，我说吃个青提蛋糕吧，想了好久了。她回我，原来重点在这儿。哈哈，也不能这么说。还没定哪天。

I just asked her if we should celebrate. She asked how, so I said, “Let's get a green grape cake. I've been craving one forever.” She wrote back, “Oh, so that's what this is about.” Haha, I wouldn't go that far. We haven't picked a day yet.
两人已经开始轻松地商量庆祝，暂时没有确定时间。他是在分享刚才的互动，不需要立刻替他们安排一次见面。
They've started talking about celebrating and haven't picked a time. He's just sharing what happened. They can make plans when they're ready.

thought: 顺着庆祝的话题聊两句
reply: 蛋糕想了很久，跟她一起庆祝是今天才有的新理由。时间你们慢慢商量，先把这份开心留着。
You've wanted that cake for a while, and now you've got a new reason to share it with her. You can pick a day later. Enjoy being excited for now.

lines: 我昨晚答应跟他在一起了。他今天早上就把我俩照片发朋友圈了，也太快了吧。
I said yes last night. He posted our photo on Moments first thing this morning. That was fast.
用户刚确认恋爱关系，对方已经公开合照，她提到速度快，但还没有说自己是否介意。先问她的感受，不急着把这件事解释为压力或喜悦。
The user just agreed to a relationship and he's already posted their photo. She said it was fast, but hasn't said whether that bothers her. Ask how it felt before reading anything into it.

thought: Ask how she felt seeing it
reply: 刚确认关系，他就想让大家知道了。你看到的时候什么感觉？
You just got together and he already wants people to know. How did you feel when you saw it?

lines: 有点好笑，也挺开心的。但我是不是也得发一条啊？想到同事都能看见，还要来问，就好尴尬。
I thought it was funny, and it made me happy. But do I have to post too? My coworkers would all see it and come ask me about it. So awkward.
用户对恋爱公开感到开心，犹豫来自熟人围观时的害羞。可以鼓励她表达喜悦，也可以支持她先私下分享，不把是否发动态等同于是否认真对待关系。

The user is happy people know they're together, but shy about people she knows making a fuss. I can encourage her to share or support her in telling someone privately. A post isn't a measure of how serious she is.

reply: 幸福不用等到不害羞才分享。既然开心，就大方晒一次。写一句自己的话就好，不用比谁更会表达。
You don't have to wait until you're past feeling shy to share something that makes you happy. If you want to post it, go for it. One line in your own words is enough.

thought: 支持她先告诉亲近的人
reply: 幸福是自己的，不必用朋友圈证明。先告诉你想告诉的人，也是一种分享。不想一下子被很多人围观，就先跟熟悉的人说说。
You can be happy without proving it on Moments. Telling the people you want to tell is sharing too. If you'd rather avoid a crowd, start with someone close to you.

lines: 我发了，写的好吧，以后一起吃饭。刚发出去我就把手机扣下了。结果我同事直接过来问，谁啊？我还得装得很平静，说就我男朋友啊。

I posted it. I wrote, “Okay, then we'll eat together from now on.” I put my phone facedown the second I posted. Then my coworker came straight over and went, “Who's that?” I had to act all calm and go, “Oh, my boyfriend.”
她已经发出动态，也经历了原先害羞的同事询问。她在分享既尴尬又高兴的小插曲，可以顺着回应，不必继续鼓励她做更多公开表达。
She posted and got the question from a coworker that she'd been dreading. It was awkward and made her happy. I can share in that without encouraging her to put anything else out there.

reply: 朋友圈发出去了，当面介绍也说出口了。看来害羞没有耽误你开心，今天可以不用装得那么平静。
The post is up and you've already said it out loud. Being shy didn't stop you from being happy. You don't have to act quite so calm today.

lines: 我给闺蜜发了照片。她连着问，什么时候的，谁先说的，见了几次。我打字都赶不上她问。本来想悄悄说一下，结果她给我打电话了。
I sent the photo to my best friend. “Since when? Who said it first? How many times have you seen each other?” I couldn't type fast enough. I thought I'd tell her quietly, then she called me.
她选择私下分享，闺蜜反而直接打来电话。她是在讲开心的热闹，可以顺着被采访的感觉开个玩笑，不需要把朋友的追问当成矛盾来处理。
She told her friend privately and got a phone call. She's enjoying how much of a fuss her friend is making. I can joke that she's being interviewed.

thought: 顺着闺蜜的热情开个玩笑
reply: 公开会被围观，私聊会被采访。看来她已经准备好听完整个故事了，你可以慢慢跟她分享。
A public post gets an audience. A private message gets an interview. Sounds like she's ready for the whole story. Take your time telling her.

lines: 我刚还跟他说，你动作也太快了。然后问他要照片原图，朋友圈那个压得有点糊。跟他说我还是喜欢拿在手里的照片，手机里存一堆，后面根本想不起来翻。

I just told him, “That was fast.” Then I asked him for the original photo. It got a little blurry on Moments. I told him, “I still like photos I can hold in my hands.” I save a ton on my phone and never remember to look at them later.
她主动索要合照原图，想以自己喜欢的方式留住照片。已经告诉男友这个偏好，可以回应这份珍惜，不需要再建议一次公开动态。
She asked for the original because she wants to keep it in a way she likes. She's already told him what she prefers. I can acknowledge that the photo matters to her.

thought: 回应她想把照片留下来
Respond to her wanting to keep it
reply: 原来害羞归害羞，照片还是要好好收着。手机里不容易翻到的，就换一种你喜欢的方式留住。
Shy or not, that photo deserves to be kept. If it's hard to find again on your phone, keep it in a way you'll enjoy.

lines: 他早上还问要不要庆祝一下。我问怎么庆祝，他说吃个青提蛋糕吧，想了好久了。怎么最后还是吃。
He asked if we should celebrate this morning. I asked how and he said, “Let's get a green grape cake. I've been craving one forever.” Somehow it's always about food in the end.
她接着分享男友提出的庆祝方式，语气带着亲近的打趣。可以回应蛋糕这个具体细节，不替他们补出尚未确定的见面安排。
She's sharing his idea for celebrating and teasing him affectionately. I can answer about the cake without assuming they've decided when to meet.

thought: 顺着他的蛋糕庆祝聊一句
reply: 原来庆祝方式已经有候选了。想了很久的蛋糕，现在又多了一个一起吃的理由。
Looks like you've got one idea for celebrating. Now you've got another reason to share the cake he's been wanting.

memories.label: 想吃青提蛋糕
memories.name: Green grape cake
quote: 吃个青提蛋糕吧，想了好久了
Let's get a green grape cake. I've been craving one forever

lines: 她刚跟我说，你动作也太快了。然后又问我要照片原图。我还以为她嫌我发得急，结果她说，我还是喜欢拿在手里的照片。原图已经发她了。

She just said, “That was fast.” Then she asked for the original photo. I thought she was bothered I posted so soon, but she said, “I still like photos I can hold in my hands.” I sent her the original.
他先担心女友嫌公开太快，随后收到索要原图的回应，感到高兴。她亲口说喜欢纸质照片，可以据此回应，不必猜测她对公开关系的全部态度。

He worried that she thought he'd posted too fast, then was happy she asked for the original. She told him she likes prints. I can use that without guessing how she feels about going public in general.

thought: 回应她主动要照片这件事
Respond to her asking for the photo
reply: 她觉得你发得快，也想把照片好好留着，这两件事可以同时成立。原图都找你要了，看来今天不只是你一个人在高兴。
She thought you posted fast, and she wants to keep the photo. Both can be true. She asked you for the original, so it looks like you're not the only one who's happy today.

memories.label: 纸质合照
memories.name: Printed photo
quote: 我还是喜欢拿在手里的照片
I still like photos I can hold in my hands

lines: 我刚看了下日历，现在就问她一个月纪念日那天有没有空，会不会太早啊，才第一天。
I just checked my calendar. Is it too early to ask if she's free for our one-month anniversary? It's only day one.
他已经开始期待一个月纪念日，犹豫的是现在提出会不会太早。可以建议先确认共同的时间，把具体安排留到之后，避免一次就把所有事情定下来。
He's looking forward to their one-month anniversary and wonders if it's too soon to bring it up. They can set aside the time and leave the details for later.

thought: 先约时间，安排慢慢商量
Save the date and plan later
reply: 可以先问问她，不用今天就把整天安排好。就说：一个月纪念日那天留给我吧，我们一起过。具体吃什么到时候再想。
You can ask without planning the whole day now. Try: “Save our one-month anniversary for me, okay? Let's spend it together. We can decide what to eat later.”

lines: 他刚说，一个月纪念日那天留给我吧，我们一起过。具体吃什么到时候再想。才第一天，他怎么已经翻到下个月了。
He just said, “Save our one-month anniversary for me, okay? Let's spend it together. We can decide what to eat later.” It's day one. How is he already looking at next month?
她转述男友的纪念日邀约，觉得他期待得很早，但没有表达拒绝。可以问她是否也想一起过，帮助她表达自己的意愿，不替她作决定。
He's looking forward to the anniversary already. She hasn't said she doesn't want to. I can help her answer based on whether she wants to spend it together.

thought: 让她按自己的期待回应
Let her answer how she feels
reply: 他已经开始期待那一天了。你也想一起过的话，就先答应，具体安排可以之后再慢慢商量。
He's already looking forward to that day. If you'd like to spend it together too, say yes. You can talk about what to do later.

lines: OK，正好那会儿项目也忙完了，放松一下。
OK, my project should be done by then anyway. I could use a chance to relax.
她已经表示愿意一起过纪念日，也期待忙完项目后能放松一下。可以支持她把时间留出来，顺着这份期待回应，不必再替两人安排具体怎么庆祝。
She's agreed to spend the anniversary with him and is looking forward to relaxing once work settles down. Support that without planning the celebration for them.

thought: 支持她留出一起过的时间
Encourage her to save the day
reply: 那就把那天先留出来。等忙完这一阵，有件一起期待的事也挺好。
Then set the day aside. It's nice to have something to look forward to together once work settles down.

lines: 她回，好啊，那天留给你。我现在就有点想准备东西。但礼物是不是挑得太早了，我还没想好送什么合适。
She said, “Sure, I'll save the day for you.” I kind of want to get something ready now. Is it too early to pick a gift, though? I haven't worked out what to get.
女友答应一起过纪念日，他想准备一点东西，又怕挑得太早。可以根据已有的小细节给建议，也可以先不急着买，在之后相处中慢慢想。

She agreed to spend their anniversary together. He wants to get her something but worries it's too early. I could use a detail he's kept, or suggest seeing what comes up as they get to know each other.

thought: Turn the photo into a gift
reply: 她说过喜欢拿在手里的照片。可以先洗一张你们的合照，背面写上在一起的日期。不用一下子准备很贵重的礼物，从她喜欢的小东西开始就好。

She said she likes photos she can hold in her hands. You could get a print of the two of you and write the date you got together on the back. It doesn't have to be expensive. Start with a little thing she likes.

thought: 先留时间，慢慢了解喜好
Save the date and learn what she likes
reply: 先不用急着买。你们刚在一起，之后聊天、见面，还会慢慢知道她喜欢什么。先把那天留好，礼物可以等有了合适的想法再准备。

You don't have to buy anything yet. You just got together. As you talk and spend more time together, you'll learn more about what she likes. Save the date for now and get something when you have a good idea.

lines: 这个好。我下单了，洗两张，一人一张。等拿到了我自己写日期，字丑也认了。
I like that. I ordered two prints, one for each of us. I'll write the date myself when they get here. Ugly handwriting and all.
合照已经下单，他还打算亲手写日期，语气很期待。可以回应这份心意，顺着他担心字丑开个小玩笑，不必再建议添别的礼物。
The photos are ordered. He's looking forward to writing the date himself. I can appreciate the gesture and joke about his handwriting without giving him more to do.

thought: 肯定他亲手准备的心意
reply: 你自己写的日期，也会成为照片的一部分。字不用写得多漂亮，先把日子写对就好。
Writing the date yourself makes it part of the photo. It doesn't have to look pretty. Just get the date right.

lines: 也是，今天才第一天。我先把那天记下来，后面想到了再说。突然觉得还挺有盼头的。
True, it's only day one. I'll put the date down and think of something later. All of a sudden it feels like I've got something to look forward to.
约定已经记下，他接受了暂时不急着买礼物，也开始期待以后的相处。可以顺着这个轻松的心情收尾，不再追加准备任务。
He's saved the date and is okay with waiting to buy a gift. He's looking forward to the time they'll spend together. Let this end on that feeling.

thought: Leave him looking forward to it
reply: 那就先期待着。接下来还有很多一起吃饭、聊天的机会，合适的主意也许就在里面。
Then enjoy looking forward to it. There'll be plenty of dinners and conversations between now and then. The right idea might come up in one of them.

lines: 我把那天记日历上了。写一个月纪念日有点不好意思，又改成了吃饭。
I put it in my calendar. I felt a little embarrassed writing “one-month anniversary,” so I changed it to “dinner.”
她把约定记进日历，连给自己看的名称都有点害羞。她是在接着分享今晚的期待，轻松回应即可，不再增加需要她完成的新安排。
She's saved the date and feels shy even about a title only she can see. She's still looking forward to it. A light response is enough.

thought: Gently pick up on her shyness
reply: 名字低调一点，期待一点没少。就让日历先替你留着那一天吧。
A low-key name doesn't make you any less excited. Let your calendar save the day for you.

lines:
我跟我女朋友在一起两周多了，刚开始天天能聊到睡觉。这礼拜她赶项目，回我基本就是累啊困啊，我又老想找她。
她刚发了张照片，买了杯喝的，说最近全靠公司楼下那家青杏续命。照片后面有个同事拿吸管夹薯条，她说大家都叫他筷子。我回了个笑哭，就没下文了。还想聊两句，你说我接点啥？

My girlfriend and I have been together a little over two weeks. At first we talked every day until bedtime. She's been trying to finish a project this week, so her replies are mostly “I'm tired” or “I'm sleepy,” and I keep wanting to message her.
She just sent a photo of a drink. Says the Green Apricot downstairs from the office is the only thing keeping her alive lately. There's a coworker in the background using straws to pick up fries. She says everyone calls him Chopsticks. I sent a cry-laugh emoji and that was it. I want to chat a little more. What should I say?
用户想继续和女友聊天，但不知道怎样接话。她刚主动分享了日常照片，可以建议从照片里的饮料聊起，既有现成的话题，也不用另外找话说。
The user wants to keep talking to his girlfriend and doesn't know how. She's just shared a photo from her day. The drink gives him something to ask about.

reply: 可以问问她喝的什么，好不好喝。她主动给你发了照片，至少这会儿愿意跟你分享点日常，不用急着找个特别有意思的话题。
Ask what she's drinking and whether it's good. She sent you a photo herself, so she's happy to share a little of her day right now. You don't have to come up with anything especially interesting.

memories.label: 青杏
memories.name: Green Apricot
quote: 公司楼下那家青杏
the Green Apricot downstairs from the office

lines:
我跟男朋友在一起两周多了。这礼拜赶项目，下班连话都不想说。他还天天跟我说今天干嘛了，我不回吧，又老惦记着。
今晚部门一起吃饭，我想先跟他说一声，又怕说完就聊起来了，吃个饭还得一直看手机。咋跟他说比较好？

My boyfriend and I have been together a little over two weeks. I've been trying to finish a project this week and I'm so drained after work I don't even want to talk. He tells me about his day every day. If I don't reply, I keep thinking about it.
My department's going out to dinner tonight. I want to tell him before I go, but I'm afraid it'll turn into a whole conversation and I'll be on my phone all through dinner. How should I say it?
用户想提前告诉男友聚餐安排，也担心因此又聊起来，吃饭时得不断回消息。可以建议她同时说明回复可能较慢、回家后再聊，让对方知道她不是突然不理人。
The user wants to tell him about the dinner and is worried she'll end up replying all the way through it. She can tell him she'll be slow to answer and will talk once she's home.

thought: Tell him the plan for tonight
reply: 可以直接跟他说：“今晚部门聚餐，可能回得慢，回家再聊。”提前说清楚安排和什么时候方便聊，比一边吃饭一边惦记着回消息轻松些。
Try: “Department dinner tonight. I might be slow to reply. Let's talk when I get home.” If you tell him your plans and when you're free, you won't have to keep thinking about replying over dinner.

lines:
行，我就这么发。我也不是不想跟他聊。昨天还有个挺逗的，他提前一站下了车，还跟我说今天地铁真快，走到出口才发现下早了。我回他一个猪头，他说走过去算了，正好把歌听完。
上礼拜一起吃饭也挺好的，就是这礼拜真累。好了我走了，别一会儿大家等我。

Okay, I'll send that. It's not that I don't want to talk to him. Yesterday was pretty funny. He got off a stop early and told me the subway was really fast today. Didn't realize till he reached the exit. I sent him a pig face. He said he'd just walk and finish listening to his song.
Dinner together last week was nice too. I'm just really tired this week. Okay, I'm going. I don't want to keep everyone waiting.
用户虽然觉得聊天累，还是愿意分享男友的趣事。现在她要出门聚餐，没有新的问题需要处理，可以简短回应，不必继续分析两人的关系。
Messaging feels tiring, but the user still wants to share funny things about him. She's headed to dinner now and has no new question. Keep it brief.

reply: 听着是挺想跟你分享的，连下错站都要说一声。那先去吃饭吧，等回家有精神了再慢慢聊。
Sounds like he likes telling you things, even when he gets off at the wrong stop. Go enjoy dinner. You can talk when you're home and have the energy.

memories.label: 提前下车
memories.name: Got off early
quote: 他提前一站下了车，还跟我说今天地铁真快
He got off a stop early and told me the subway was really fast today

lines: 我跟女朋友刚闹了点不愉快。她今晚部门聚餐，吃完回来找我聊天，我问着问着就问岔了，现在她不回我了。你帮我看看，是不是我说得有点过了？

My girlfriend and I just had a bit of a fight. She went out with her department tonight and messaged me when she got back. I asked one thing, then another, and somehow it went wrong. Now she isn't replying. Can you help me figure out if I went too far?
他觉得刚才的话可能说重了，想知道怎么补救。目前还不清楚争执经过，需要先听双方说了什么，再判断问题出在哪，不能只凭她不回复就下结论。
He thinks he might've said something harsh and wants to know how to fix it. I need to hear what they both said. Her not replying on its own doesn't tell me what went wrong.

reply: 可以，把刚才那几句发来看看。你说了什么，她怎么回的，从哪儿开始不对劲的，我们先捋一下。
Sure. Send me the things you said. What did you say, how did she answer, and where did it start to feel off? Let's go through it.

lines:
她说周四方案过了，今天大家一起庆功，还发了张合照给我。我问怎么没听她说，她说昨天忙忘了。
然后说小周还张罗着给她点了个蛋糕。我问小周是谁，她说一起做项目的同事。
他们都知道，就我现在才知道。这两天她跟我说的全是累，我还以为还没忙完呢。

She said their proposal got approved Thursday and they all went out to celebrate today. She sent me a group photo too. I asked why I hadn't heard about it and she said she was busy yesterday and forgot.
Then she said Xiao Zhou had even ordered her a cake. I asked who Xiao Zhou was. She said he's a coworker on the project.
They all knew, and I'm just finding out now. The last two days all she told me was how tired she was. I thought she was still working on it.
同事参与同一个项目，知道进展很正常。他反复提到自己才知道，可能更在意没被分享这份开心。可以先帮他分清这两件事，再听后面发生了什么。

It's natural her coworkers would know how their project was going. He keeps coming back to finding out late. What may hurt more is that she didn't share the good news with him. I can untangle those two things before hearing the rest.

reply: 一起做项目的同事知道进展，并不奇怪。让你不舒服的，可能是她这两天只跟你说累，庆功这么高兴的事，你反而到现在才听说。
It makes sense that the people working on the project knew. What might sting is that all you heard for two days was how tired she was, and you're only hearing about the celebration now.

lines:
对。我就问她，你跟他私下是不是也聊挺多，不然怎么他什么都知道。她说大家一起吃饭，又不是只有我一个女的，他跟我做同一个项目，当然知道。
我又说，那给我看看你俩聊什么了。她回，你自己听听你在说什么。我接了句那你说我该怎么想，她就不回了。
我现在想解释一下，可再发过去，是不是又像追着她问？

Yeah. I asked her, “Do you two talk a lot in private too? How else does he know everything?” She said, “The whole group went. I wasn't the only woman there. We're on the same project. Of course he knows.”
Then I said, “Let me see what you two talked about.” She said, “Listen to what you're saying.” I said, “Well, what am I supposed to think?” Then she stopped replying.
I want to explain myself, but if I send another message, will it sound like I'm still going after her?
她已解释同事关系，他仍提出查看私聊，对方随后不再回复。现在想补救，应先建议撤回这项要求，承认自己问过了，而不是继续解释为什么怀疑。

She explained how she knows him. He still asked to see their private messages, and then she stopped replying. If he wants to repair things, he can take back that demand and own how far he went before explaining his suspicions.

thought: 先收回查看私聊的要求
Take back the demand to see the chat
reply: 可以再发，但这次先别解释她为什么让你多想。先承认刚才的要求不合适：“我不该让你给我看聊天，刚才有点急。”发完给她一点时间，不要接着追问。

You can send something, but leave out why she made you suspicious. Start by saying the demand was out of line: “I shouldn't have asked to see your messages. I got a little worked up.” Then give her time. Leave it at that for now.

lines:
我刚不是去部门聚餐了吗，吃完回家跟他说了两句，真的给我气到了。
周四方案过了，今天大家一起庆功。我给他发合照，说小周还给我点了个蛋糕。他先问怎么没告诉他，又问小周是谁。

Remember how I went to my department dinner? I got home and went to tell him about it. I'm so pissed off.
Our proposal got approved Thursday and we went out to celebrate today. I sent him the group photo and told him Xiao Zhou had ordered me a cake. First he asked why I hadn't told him. Then he asked who Xiao Zhou was.
她按之前的安排，聚餐后回家和男友聊天，却因为对方的追问生气。目前只听到争执的开头，需要先了解她怎么解释、对方怎么回应，不急着判断谁的问题。
She got home and talked to him as planned, but his questions made her angry. I've only heard the start. I need to hear what she explained and how he answered before deciding what went wrong.

reply: 你本来是想跟他分享庆功的事，结果聊得不愉快了。后来你怎么解释的，他又说了什么？
You wanted to share the celebration and it turned into an argument. What did you tell him after that? What did he say back?

lines:
我说昨天忙忘了告诉他，小周就是一起做项目的同事。大家一起吃饭，又不是只有我一个女的。
他还问你跟他私下是不是也聊挺多，不然怎么他什么都知道。我解释了只是同事，他还要看我和人家的聊天记录。
我说你自己听听你在说什么。他又来句，那你说我该怎么想。我真想骂人，他要怎么想还得我教啊？

I said I got busy yesterday and forgot to tell him. Xiao Zhou's just a coworker on the project. The whole group went. I wasn't the only woman there.
Then he goes, “Do you two talk a lot in private too? How else does he know everything?” I explained we're just coworkers, and he still wanted to see our chat history.
I said, “Listen to what you're saying.” Then he goes, “Well, what am I supposed to think?” I could've sworn at him. Do I have to teach him how to think now?
同事关系和聚餐情况已经解释，他仍要求看私聊，还把怎么理解这件事交给她回答。她现在很愤怒，可以先回应被怀疑的不适，建议暂缓争执，而不是继续证明清白。

She explained who he was and who went to dinner. He still wanted to see the chat and made her responsible for how he should interpret it. I can acknowledge how angry she is at being suspected and suggest pausing the argument.

reply: 你已经解释了，他还是要看聊天，难怪你会觉得说什么都像在被审问。现在正在气头上，可以先停一下，不用继续一条条证明自己和同事没什么。

You explained it and he still wanted to see the chat. No wonder it feels like you're being interrogated whatever you say. You're angry right now. You can pause without having to prove, point by point, that nothing happened with your coworker.

memories.label: 查看私聊
memories.name: Asked to see the chat
quote: 我解释了只是同事，他还要看我和人家的聊天记录
I explained we're just coworkers, and he still wanted to see our chat history

lines:
昨天按你说的发了，我不该让你给我看聊天，刚才有点急。她没回。今天中午又问吃饭没，也没回。
她一整天没回我，连我说不该问她要聊天记录也没回。刚下楼买个东西，我都一直拿着手机，就怕她突然回了我没看见。现在又想发，你说再问一句会不会更烦她啊？

I sent what you suggested yesterday: “I shouldn't have asked to see your messages. I got a little worked up.” No reply. At lunchtime I asked if she'd eaten. No reply either.
She didn't answer me all day, not even when I said I shouldn't have asked to see the chat. I went downstairs to buy something and held my phone the whole time in case she replied and I missed it. Now I want to send something again. Think that'll just annoy her more?
已经道歉，也试着恢复日常聊天，仍然没有回应。他现在很难忍住继续发消息，需要先了解他希望从下一条回复里确认什么，再考虑是否适合发送。
He's apologized and tried starting an ordinary conversation. He still hasn't heard back. It's hard for him to stop sending messages. Find out what he's hoping the next reply will tell him.

thought: Ask what he wants to know
reply: 你已经道过歉，也问过吃饭了，还是一直惦记着手机。现在想再发一句，是还有话没说，还是想从她的回复里确认什么？

You've apologized and asked if she's eaten, and you still can't put your phone down. Do you want to send something because there's more you need to say, or because you want her reply to tell you something?

memories.label: 一天没回
memories.name: No reply all day
quote: 她一整天没回我，连我说不该问她要聊天记录也没回
She didn't answer me all day, not even when I said I shouldn't have asked to see the chat

lines:
我就想知道她还想不想理我啊。昨天说小周给她点蛋糕，聊得那么高兴，到我这就一句都没了。
我现在真想问问她，到底是没空回，还是光不想回我。

I just want to know if she still wants anything to do with me. Yesterday she was so happy telling me Xiao Zhou ordered her a cake, and now I get nothing.
I really want to ask if she's too busy to reply or just doesn't want to reply to me.
他把不回消息和昨晚的同事联系起来了，但还没有提供其他依据。需要先确认他知道什么，避免顺着焦虑把猜测说成事实，也不要替女友解释沉默。
He's linking her silence to yesterday's coworker, but hasn't said anything else to support it. Find out what he knows without turning his fear into a fact or explaining her silence for her.

thought: Separate what he knows from what he guesses
reply: 你现在想确认的，其实是她还愿不愿意理你。不过，先别从她和同事的互动里猜答案。除了昨天的聚餐，还有什么让你觉得他们不只是同事吗？

What you really want to know is whether she still wants to talk to you. Try not to read the answer into how she was with her coworker. Apart from dinner yesterday, have you seen anything that makes you think they're more than coworkers?

lines:
没看到。我后来把合照翻了好几遍，他俩也没挨着坐。可他给她点个蛋糕，她就那么开心，我怎么就没想到呢。
我连他俩聊过什么都不知道，就问她是不是私下聊很多，还让她给我看聊天。
我知道这么问不好听。可我不问，就只能等她哪天想起来了再来找我吗？

No. I went back through the group photo a bunch of times. They weren't even sitting next to each other. But he ordered her a cake and she was that happy. Why didn't I think of that?
I didn't even know what they'd talked about, and I asked if they talk a lot in private and told her to show me the chat.
I know it sounds bad. But if I don't ask, am I just supposed to wait until she remembers to talk to me someday?
他承认没有证据，但仍把追问当成确认关系的唯一办法。可以建议他表达等不到回复的不安，同时明确这与要求查看私聊不同，避免再次发出带猜疑的质问。
He admits he has no evidence, but still sees questioning her as his only way to know where they stand. He can tell her waiting makes him anxious. That's different from asking to see a private chat.

reply: 等不到回复让你不安，这件事可以等能好好说话时告诉她。可让她证明没跟别人聊，并不能回答你在她心里有没有位置。今晚先别再发“是不是忙着回别人”这样的质问了。

You can tell her that waiting for a reply makes you anxious once you can talk properly. Asking her to prove she hasn't been talking to someone else can't tell you how much you matter to her. For tonight, leave questions like “Too busy replying to somebody else?” unsent.

memories.label: 要求看私聊
memories.name: Demanded to see the chat
quote: 我连他俩聊过什么都不知道，就问她是不是私下聊很多，还让她给我看聊天
I didn't even know what they'd talked about, and I asked if they talk a lot in private and told her to show me the chat

lines:
他昨天后来发了句我不该让你给我看聊天，刚才有点急。今天中午又问吃饭没，我都没回。
刚才手机亮了一下，我还以为又是他，结果是我同桌。发现不是他，我又去点开他那边看，也没再发。真让我回吧，我又不想回，烦死了。

He wrote last night, “I shouldn't have asked to see your messages. I got a little worked up.” At lunch today he asked if I'd eaten. I didn't answer either one.
My phone lit up just now and I thought it was him again. It was my deskmate. When I saw it wasn't him I checked his chat anyway. Still nothing. If I actually had to reply, I wouldn't want to. It's so annoying.
她没有回复，却反复查看男友有没有新消息，说明这件事仍让她在意。需要先了解她想等到怎样的回应，不能因为她关注手机，就认定她已经愿意和好。
She hasn't replied, but keeps checking whether he sent anything. She still cares about this. Find out what she wants to hear before assuming she's ready to make up.

reply: 你不想回他，又忍不住看他有没有再找你。你现在是还想等他说点什么，还是也想找个机会回他，只是不知道怎么开头？
You don't want to reply, but you still check whether he's messaged you. Are you hoping he'll say something else, or do you want a chance to reply but don't know how to start?

lines: 不知道，反正我现在不想回。他昨天都那么问我了，后来说一句有点急，就完了？我再跟他聊吃饭没啥的，搞得好像啥事都没有一样。

I don't know. I just don't want to answer right now. He talked to me like that yesterday, then said he got a little worked up, and that's it? If I go back to chatting about what I ate, it'll be like nothing happened.
她担心一恢复日常聊天，就等于接受这次道歉，所以不愿回复。可以先回应这个顾虑，再问收到消息时的想法，了解她是需要独处，还是想通过不回应表达不满。

She's worried going back to everyday talk amounts to accepting the apology. I can acknowledge that and ask what she felt when the message came. Is she taking time alone or using silence to show she's upset?

thought: 问她收到消息时怎么想
Ask what went through her mind
reply: 你不想一句“有点急”就把这件事翻过去。不过，不回消息能让他知道你生气了，未必能让他知道你在气什么。今天他问你吃饭没的时候，你当时怎么想的？

You don't want “I got a little worked up” to be the end of it. Staying quiet might tell him you're angry, but it might not tell him what upset you. What went through your mind when he asked if you'd eaten?

lines:
看见了，就是不想回。我今天手机一直在用，跟同桌聊桌游，跟别人说话，就没理他。
我就是故意一天不回他，想让他也难受一下。凭什么每次都是我被问得烦啊，他也等一等吧。

I saw it. I just didn't want to answer. I've been on my phone all day, talking board games with my deskmate, talking to other people. I just ignored him.
I deliberately didn't answer him all day. I wanted him to feel bad too. Why am I always the one getting grilled? Let him wait for once.
她明确说自己想让对方难受，不回应已经不只是为了休息。需要听她接下来想怎么做，把继续冷落和表达不满分开，不替她把这次行为解释成无意的。

She says outright she wanted him to feel bad. This is doing more than giving her time to recover. Find out what she wants to do next and distinguish keeping him waiting from telling him why she's mad.

thought: Ask what she wants to do next
reply: 你是想让他也尝尝被晾着的滋味。那接下来呢，你还想继续晾着，还是想让他知道，你到底为什么那么生气？
You wanted him to see how it feels to be left hanging. What do you want now? To keep leaving him hanging, or to let him know why you were that angry?

memories.label: 故意不回
memories.name: Didn't reply on purpose
quote: 我就是故意一天不回他，想让他也难受一下
I deliberately didn't answer him all day. I wanted him to feel bad too

lines:
今天不想跟他说了。他要是又问小周，我真会骂他。那些话我现在想想都烦。
我同桌还问明天去不去桌游，我说先不去了。现在出去玩都能想起他昨天那几句。

I don't want to talk to him today. If he brings up Xiao Zhou again I'll go off on him. Just thinking about what he said makes me angry.
My deskmate asked if I wanted to play board games tomorrow. I said I'd skip it. Even if I went out, I'd just think about what he said yesterday.
她目前不愿直接和男友谈，继续劝回复可能只会增加抵触。可以建议先找可信的人聊聊，让她把不满说出来，再决定如何联系，而不是让别人替她处理。
She doesn't want to talk to him directly right now. Pushing her to answer could make her resist it more. Suggest someone she trusts to talk it through without asking them to sort it out for her.

thought: 找熟悉双方的同桌聊聊
reply: 你同桌也是他表妹，跟你俩都熟。可以先找她聊聊，她也许能帮你理理怎么跟他说。先说明你只是想聊这件事，不是让她替你去传话。

Your deskmate is his cousin, and she knows you both. You could talk it over with her first. She might help you figure out what to say. Let her know you're just there to talk and don't want her carrying messages for you.

thought: 建议先找可信的朋友吐槽
Talk to a friend she trusts
reply: 可以先找个信得过的朋友说说，不必憋着，也不必现在就回他。等这口气缓一点，再想你希望他听明白什么，可能比反复盯着聊天框轻松些。

Tell a friend you trust how you're feeling. You can let it out without replying to him right now. When you're less angry, think about what you want him to understand. That might feel easier than checking the chat again and again.

lines: 那我找我闺蜜说说吧。我俩认识好多年了，她跟他又不熟，不用夹在中间。跟她说话我就不用憋着了。
I'll talk to my best friend, then. We've known each other for years, and she barely knows him. She won't get stuck in the middle. I can say what I really think with her.
她选择找熟悉自己的闺蜜，对方与男友不熟，可以让她少一些顾虑。现在已有明确打算，回复只需确认，不继续追问或要求她立刻想好给男友的答复。
Her best friend knows her well and isn't close to him. That makes it easier to speak freely. She's made a plan. No need to ask more of her or have her work out a reply right now.

thought: Let her talk to her best friend
reply: 那就先找她聊。你现在不必一边吐槽，一边急着想该怎么回男友，先把自己憋着的那部分说出来。
Then talk to her first. You don't have to figure out what to say to your boyfriend while you're venting. Start with whatever you've been holding in.

lines: 那我找她说两句。我得先跟她说好啊，别替我去找他，我还没想好怎么回。
I'll talk to her, then. I have to say this first: don't go talk to him for me. I haven't figured out what to say back.
她愿意找同桌聊，也明确不希望被代为传话。可以肯定她先说明这一点，避免朋友的介入变成新的误会，是否联系男友仍由她自己决定。
She's willing to talk to her deskmate and doesn't want her to pass anything on. Back her up in saying that first so it doesn't turn into another misunderstanding.

thought: Make clear she doesn't want a go-between
reply: 对，先把这点说清楚。你现在是想有人听你讲，不是请她去劝他；等你想好怎么说，再由你自己联系。
Yes, say that first. You want someone to hear you out. If you decide to talk to him, you can do it yourself when you know what you want to say.

lines:
我昨天跟闺蜜打了挺久电话。她先陪我骂了几句，说换谁被这么问都得烦。后来突然问我，那你还想不想见他？
我说想啊。她就说，想见就去见，该说他的地方还得说，别自己跟这儿憋一晚上。聊完确实没那么气了。
今天醒来又想找他。可我先去找，他是不是就觉得昨天这事过去了？

I was on the phone with my best friend for ages yesterday. She let me rant, said anyone would be mad after being questioned like that. Then out of nowhere she asked, “Do you still want to see him?”
I said yes. She went, “Then go see him. You can still tell him what he did wrong. Don't sit there stewing all night.” I was less mad after that.
I woke up wanting to talk to him. But if I reach out first, will he think I'm over what happened?
